description: Capacity-skill trade-off: greedy matching assigns repair to Alice (closest) but then cannot fit install (only Alice has it). Optimal: reserve Alice for install, send Bob for repair.

optimal_solution.notes: Alice (A, 3h capacity) gets job 2 (install at A, only she can do it). Bob (B, 8h) gets jobs 1 (repair at A, travel 1h) and 3 (repair at B). Bob route: B->A->B = 2.0h travel. Jobs: 4.0h. Total: 6.0h <= 8.0h. All jobs assigned.
